body.p: Once upon a time there lived an Evenki hero with the name Hendincha [lit. jumper]. And there was a Nenets hero with the name Satira [lit. polar fox]. They knew each other from stories. When the Evenki hero had gotten to know about that strong man, he went down the river Yenisei. Their meeting place was on a hill. Satira came earlier than Hendincha. He saw his friend running, he shot at him. Hendincha jumped up, the arrow flew past under his foot. Hendincha said: "You shot in vain". Satira was afraid of his friend: "You can't be killed by a human". Therefore the hero [Satira] went back to himself. His friend [Hendincha] returned to his relatives. Having come he said: "He was boasting in vain". In the next year, Satira sent his people to the hill where they should meet. Hendincha's people, when [Satira's people] came, were waiting for their arrival. The battle began. Satira's people began to die. Some of them ran away. Therefore he himself and his people lost against Hendincha and his people. From then on they stopped boasting each other and started to live together well.
